Line.DefaultText: A full year later, on the first cold night, I finally sat down and spun the rest of it. My hands remembered hers, somehow. The thread came out even, no knots, no breaks, the whole length of it. I still don't know how, patient hand or not. I keep telling myself I made it. Truthfully I think we made it together.

Answer.DefaultText: What did you do with the thread?
